description: NaGa₃P₂(HO₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.79 Å. There are three inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.23 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.13 Å. In the third Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-55°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two Ga, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Ga and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Ga and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ga and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Ga and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ga and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ga, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom.
